These findings were widely interpreted as strong support for the hypothesis Approximate Number System (ANS) plays a causal role in mathematics, this relation holds into adulthood. Here we report four experiments fail to find evidence relation. Experiment 1 examined whether arithmetic effect exists within shorter period than originally (2 vs 6 days of training). 2 attempted replicate compare control condition matched working memory load. Experiments 3 4 replicated original larger sample size. Across all (N = 318) was no more effective at improving adults tasks. Results call question any relationship between approximate, non-symbolic precise arithmetic.
